summary: 15 Java files written for LRE from scratch; all 51 requirements traced; build clean; 5 items for review.

issues.title: SAFE_DISTANCE default invented (1000.0 m)
issues.raw: LRE-DM5 requires a 'safe large distance' default but fixes no value.
issues.fix_directive: Set Sensor.SAFE_DISTANCE if the spec intends a specific value.

issues.title: cda default conflicts between LRE-DM5 and LRE-OP5
issues.raw: LRE-DM5 zeroes nsRelDist/ewRelDist with no obstacle (cda would be 0); LRE-OP5 promises large-distance defaults.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm the LRE-OP5 reading; cda is computed as sqrt(hdist^2 - (r.v)^2/|v|^2) so it degenerates to hdist.

issues.title: No entry action on CAM
issues.raw: LRE-FR4 names evasive manoeuvres but no advVel/advHdng value.
issues.fix_directive: State the advised velocity for CAM in LRE-FR4 if one is required.

issues.title: State variables held by the operation classes
issues.raw: LRE-Var1..8 say the controller maintains them; they are operation-class fields surfaced as named predicates in step().
issues.fix_directive: Accept, or move the variables onto LreController as fields assigned at the top of step().

issues.title: MOM<->HCM guards not complementary on the vertical thresholds
issues.raw: staticObsVertDist and staticObsDfltVertDist are distinct constants, so Beh10 and Beh13 can both be enabled in the extracted model.
issues.fix_directive: If FDR4 reports divergence, conjoin !vdistCstcAtMostDfltVert into the HCM->MOM guard.
